description: Recommends the most useful agent skills for the next step of a live coding-agent session (sr). Ranking requires a TypeSafe.ai Jev API key.
notes: sr needs a TypeSafe.ai API key to rank: set TYPESAFE_API_KEY (sign up at https://console.typesafe.ai).
Network use is off by default; enable it in trusted user configuration or with --allow-network.
On Windows sr ranks statelessly: the cache, ledger and request allowance are unavailable.
To add the Claude Code hook, preview with 'sr install-hook claude', then apply with --apply.
